title: Yara and the Wardrobe
author: Odile Oyelaran
blurb: Isandro Kavanagh, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
